question: Does the mixed-use proposal comply with the C-2 and Airport Overlay rules?
reasoning: C-2 permits both multifamily housing and neighborhood retail. The 10,000-square-meter parcel equals one hectare, so the 72 apartments are below the 80-unit density cap. zoning_rules: The C-2 district permits multifamily housing and neighborhood retail, with a maximum of 80 dwelling units per hectare and maximum lot coverage of 55%. The overlay height limit applies in addition to the base-district rules and may not be exceeded through an administrative adjustment.
